scheme_name: Commemoration of Jubilees/Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears
description:
The Commemoration of Jubilees and Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Goa. 

This scheme was launched on 1st January 2020. 

It aims to honor and recognize the contributions of Tiatr artistes who have played a significant role in the cultural heritage of Goa. 

Tiatr is a form of musical theatre that originated in Goa and has a rich history dating back to the 19th century. 

The scheme was introduced to preserve and promote this unique art form. 

The objectives of the scheme include the recognition of the contributions of Tiatr artistes. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to the families of deceased Tiatr artistes. 

The scheme also seeks to encourage the younger generation to take an interest in Tiatr. 

The government aims to commemorate the birth anniversaries of notable Tiatr artistes. 

The scheme includes organizing events and functions to celebrate these anniversaries. 

Financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at ₹1 lakh. 

This amount is given to the families of deceased artistes as a one-time grant. 

The scheme is designed to ensure that the contributions of these artistes are not forgotten. 

Eligibility for this scheme includes being a resident of Goa. 

The applicant must be a family member of a deceased Tiatr artiste. 

The deceased artiste must have made significant contributions to Tiatr. 

The family must provide proof of the artiste's contributions. 

The application process involves submitting a formal application to the Directorate of Art and Culture, Goa. 

Applicants must include documents such as the death certificate of the artiste. 

They must also provide proof of the artiste's work in Tiatr. 

A copy of the applicant's identity proof is also required. 

The application must be submitted within six months of the artiste's death. 

The government has set a timeline for the disbursement of funds. 

Once the application is approved, the funds are disbursed within 30 days. 

The Directorate of Art and Culture is responsible for implementing this scheme. 

This department oversees the application process and the disbursement of funds. 

The contact details for the Directorate of Art and Culture are available on their official website. 

The scheme also includes organizing cultural events to celebrate the lives of these artistes. 

These events serve to educate the public about the history of Tiatr. 

They also provide a platform for upcoming artistes to showcase their talent. 

The government aims to organize at least two major events each year under this scheme. 

These events will coincide with the birth anniversaries of notable Tiatr artistes. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the community. 

It has been instrumental in raising awareness about the importance of Tiatr. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 lakh for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2020-2021. 

This budget is expected to cover the financial assistance and the costs of organizing events. 

The scheme is part of the larger initiative to promote Goan culture. 

It aligns with the government's efforts to preserve traditional art forms. 

The Tiatr community has expressed gratitude for the recognition provided by this scheme. 

Many families of deceased artistes have benefited from the financial assistance. 

The scheme has also encouraged younger generations to engage with Tiatr. 

Workshops and training sessions are being planned to support this engagement. 

The government is collaborating with local theatre groups to facilitate these workshops. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over the years based on community feedback. 

The Directorate of Art and Culture is open to suggestions for improvements. 

The government aims to expand the scope of the scheme in the future. 

This may include additional financial support for living artistes. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to cultural preservation. 

It highlights the importance of recognizing the contributions of artists to society. 

The Tiatr community continues to thrive due to such initiatives. 

The scheme has also sparked interest in Tiatr among tourists. 

It has the potential to boost cultural tourism in Goa. 

The government plans to promote Tiatr through various media channels. 

This includes social media campaigns and collaborations with influencers. 

The long-term goal is to establish Tiatr as a recognized art form nationally. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in achieving this goal. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

The government remains committed to supporting the arts and culture sector. 

This scheme is just one of many efforts to uplift traditional art forms in India. 

The success of the scheme will be measured by the engagement of the community. 

The government will continue to monitor its impact on the Tiatr community. 

The scheme represents a significant step towards cultural recognition and support. 

It is an essential initiative for preserving the rich heritage of Goa. 

The government encourages more families to come forward and apply for assistance. 

This scheme is a vital part of ensuring that the legacy of Tiatr continues for future generations. 

The Commemoration of Jubilees and Birth Anniversaries of Tiatr Artistes of Yesteryears is a significant welfare scheme. 

It embodies the spirit of gratitude and recognition for the contributions of artists. 

The government of Goa is dedicated to fostering a vibrant cultural landscape through such initiatives.
